t: This is Ashburnham House, an extended seventeenth-century house on Little Dean's Yard in Westminster. Since 1882 it has been part of Westminster School. It's occasionally open to the public, and when it is, the highlights are its staircase and the first-floor drawing rooms. Sydney Stanhope, the sixth Earl of Harrington, was born here. He was an English peer, and he lived from 1845 to 1866, so he died young, at just twenty or twenty-one.
